content: Koti nkaobi a'ya'ma kina'miba ka'masa puma miyewe
We, nao'mitaba, tigeba e'wasa Wa'egare Isu Karaisititi timatiti pota'nagitaba, wasana intapera tumintapera ka kana puwaitaiyo.
Piya, tigeba monota ai'aru piginaba, ka yagarama aeba kasa'ena autasaenabe awa'enawape purite pasekana, to ka kusi yagaramaba abaraena autasaena purite asu pasekiripa,
tigeba aogi autasaena purinta'nagipa: Mata'i kanama aogi yabaera ampiyo, omintiri, to ka kusi yagarakaba: Kaeba pagasara asima miyo, omikibewo: Tagisabi mpara miyo, omikibewo. Piya ukibepa ataenawe.
Tigeba piyaena puntiripa, tiyotimpipa pako puwaitawe. We, piyaena puntiripa, tigeba agunta napiyena waintaga kina mima, kamana abima atama a'yiki kina kanta puma miyewe.

We, nabugai ntao'nempitaba, abiyo. Koti untegini, mamparasaenaga kusi pe kina'miba imatiti'enawaimpaba kota wainta kina kanta pumagini kabiratakenaenabi ubasikibewe. Eya, Kotiba pi kinapa uwaitantikini, igeba agu kao'ena potaompe kina'mite nkutaratanta'enabi ubasikibewe.
We, tigeba kusi kina'mi nkigeba maete tumima ataenaba pewe. Pigoya, ae kina'mi kuntaena timewe. Ae kina'mi tibabuma kamana uritawe. Kota wainta kina igeba piyaba puritawe. Kusi kinapa kampaye.
Piya, kota wainta kina'mi igeba tiba puritanti nkagiba akayasotawe. Eya, igeba Karaisiti nkaota agiba maete tumewe.
Pigoya, kabiratakenaenama nkago kamana'amaba mono isapipa maya iye: Kaeka kau kabitampesa puma kagorasa kinapa agu kao'ena potao, iye. Pi kamana agoba wasiyigina kanarasano.
Piya, tigeba wasana pako puma tabe kina'amana aogi potantiripa, tigeba aguntaenaba pewe. Piya piginaba, ago kamana'amaba tigu'amapi piyekiri, tigeba kamana akayukena kinatawe.
Piya, ka'waina aeba ka kamana aemita pipa, a'ya'ma to kamana agoba aegaraginaba, Koti nkaobipa a'ya'ma kamana'ama nkagoba aemita piye.
Piya, kumiyenaba a-po unti ntagaramaba: Wasanaba a-nkaeguyegana pureno, untiye. We, ka'waina kumiyenaba kampa punta, wasana aeguma kaiyipa, aeba ago kamana akayukena yagara miye.
Pigoya, aguntaenabisa akariyoba titami kamanakaba Kotiba napima a'yigititakiye. Pika tigeba napima aogi kamana uma aogiyena peno.
Piya, antara'ena kampa pukibi'napa Kotiba kampa antara'ena potama kamana otakiye. We, antara'enamaba kamana otakenaenaba agaikiye.
Tamatiti'enama nkau'wampantanawe
We, nao'nempitaba, ka'waina aeba kampa aogi yugaba puma: Namatiti'enayaga mintuwe, ukibipa, ayama ao'maekiye, a. Amatiti'enawapa ayama au'ikiye, a.
Piya, tiyo'yagaramaba autasaenabe nakenabe aisa'ma mintakanaba,
tigepisa ka'wainaba: Aogima mima agoya pegana kaga'e pano, omintana, i'anape nanintabe kampa ameganaba, au'amaba ayamabaya aborama ao'maekiye. Pipa kampaye.
Piya puma, amatiti'ena abiwapa waima au'wantaga yuga kampa aboraginaba, pi nkamatiti'enamaba pu'wasu piye.

We, ka yagarama: Kaeba kamatiti peka, naeba aogi yuga puwe, unamikiyema napiyuwe. Pigoya, naeba maya omukuwe: Kaeba ayama kamatiti'enamana nayakega, pabiyama aogi yuganetasa namatiti'enaba kayakikuwe, omukuwe.
We, tigeba: Ka Koti mintiye, uma abegana kanarasaye. Abiyo. Kewamabeba kaga pi kamanapa abima, igeba tabaraba pewe.
We, tigeba aibo'ena pewe. Timatiti'enamana puntiri au'wampa ntugaba kampa aborakibepa, timatiti'enarimpaba anamo wae kanta pukibewe. Pi'na nkagoba tiyakisuwa, a.
Piya, paipa tayabama Abara'amuba aeba Koti nkawamu wasima, yagarawapa Aisakipa muta atakena arata yareri atantine. Piya pogana Kotiba yogawata agategina: Arupu yagarawe, otantine.
Piya, tigeba ago abewe. Amatiti'enabe aogi yugabe kaga puntine. Eya, amatiti'enawampa nkaupa yogawane.

Piya, paipa Abara'amuba Kotiti amatiti pogana, Kotiba agama arupu potantiyema, mono isa'ama uramiye. Pi kamanapa Abara'amu yogawatasa esegi potantiye. Aibogini, wasanamiba: Aeba Koti nkao'yagarawe, otantawe.
Piya, ibaba tigeba abewe. Amatiti'enamana nane. Amatiti'enama nkau'wapa pipa aogi yugarasa wasana arupu yagara aboraye.
Piya pumagina, kumi wae Areyabu aeba ma agakena kinapa kabiwaisitama to ki'i uwaisitaoginisi wantase. Piya pometaka: Arupu waene, otantiye.
Piya, au'ama nkaumawapa kampa waintipa pu'waisa puma, amatiti'enama ntuga kampa aboraipa pu'wasu piye.
